scenes.title: Dusk on the Glass Causeway
scenes.summary: The party arrives at dusk with the river gate closing in four bells. Sera Venn warns them, shares a rumor of the Lantern Widow under the bridge, and shows a broken seal while the gate clock stands at one of four segments. Rowan suspects Sera of working for the raiders and wants to ask the gatekeeper about the seal.

scenes.title: Red cord at the ferry landing
scenes.summary: The gatekeeper leaves a red cord tied to the post at the ferry landing while the party is still there at dusk.
